caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular embroidered sampler bordered with a thin red line and filled with various motifs on a pale background. At the center is a red house with a tan roof, green shuttered windows, and a white staircase leading to the ground. Surrounding the house are green plants with pink-red flowers, along with several pink hearts and heart-shaped brown and red motifs in each corner. There are also animals and birds in the scene: a large white swan, a black dog near the house, a black cat at the bottom, and two pink birds facing inward on either side. A human figure in a black dress stands to the left of the house, raising one arm. There are four red eight-pointed stars distributed around the composition, and a large green eight-pointed star below the swan. The piece presents a balanced arrangement of flora, fauna, human, and geometric motif elements. The drawing is signed “drawn by J. D. Le Strange” and labeled “Westchester County” at the bottom. It also notes the scale as "2 in = 1 ft."
title: Rug or Wall Hanging
